definitions.short: to tie fast; hence (of the mouth) to be tongue-tied
definitions.usage: bind, be dumb, put to silence.
definitions.full: H481. alam [ אָלַם ] verb bind (perhaps compare Assyrian [ al¹mu ], almattu , fortress Dl in Zim BP 114 & in BD Ezek.:xi ; Arabic be in pain , Aramaic retain anger). Niph`al ( be bound =) be dumb, Perfect 3feminine singular נֶאֱלָ֑מָה Isa 53:7 ; וְנֶאֱלַמְתָּ֫ Ezek 3:26 , etc.; Imperfect 2masculine singular תֵּאָלֵם 24:27 ; 3 feminine plural תֵּאָלַמְנָה Psa 31:19 . — 1 be dumb , i.e. silent 39:3 ׳נ דוּמִיָּה (|| הֶחֱשֵׁיתִי ); compare 39:10 (|| אֶפְתַּחמִּֿי לֹא ); simile of sheep Isa 53:7 (|| id. ); be dumb , i.e. unable to speak Ezek 3:26 (result of אֶלחִֿכָּ֑ךָ אַדְבִּיק וּלְשׁוֺנְךָ ) compare 24:27 עוֺד תֵאָלֵם וְלֹא וּתְדַבֵּר ֗֗֗ מִּיךָ יִמָּתַח ; 33:22 עוֺד נֶאֱלַמְתִּי וְלֹא מִּי וַיִּפְתַּח ; also Dan 10:15 (compare 10:16 ); be made dumb subject שָׁ֑קֶר שִׂפְתֵי lying lips Psa 31:19 (|| לִשְׁאוֺל יִדְּמוּ 31:18 ). Pi`el Participle bind Gen 37:7 (E) אֲלֻמִּים מְאַלְּמִים binding sheaves .

occurrences.englishText: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”
Oh how great is your goodness,
My heart was hot within me.
Remove your scourge away from me.
I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth, that you will be mute, and will not be able to correct them; for they are a rebellious house.
In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak, and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”
Now Yahweh’s hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.
When he had spoken these words to me, I set my face toward the ground, and was mute.
